what: The plugin compiles in the vxl project: all four modules, with UHT on the USTRUCTs (FUniCoord, FUniCellKey, FUniObjectId) and the UFUNCTION library.
UE Automation tests (UnifiedUniverse.*) pass headless with -nullrhi, including engine-parity checks of the UniSeed port against ProcSeed / HashCombine / FRandomStream.
Every .usf entry point compiles under the engine shader compiler (DXC was not runnable here).
GPU execution parity: the shared cores give the same results on the GPU as their CPU runs through UniHlslShim.h (integer cores bitwise, float cores statistically, D-105).
Render hooks: the scene view extension subscribes at the intended points on the project's engine version (D-006), and sprites appear with scene-depth occlusion.
Flythrough in the editor: `uu.Flythrough` console command on an empty level shows the backdrop, with no jitter and no pops.

Promotion handoff appearance: the reference renderer showed the sprite's glare far larger than the promoted body (OBSERVATIONS.md). In UE there is no promotion actor pool yet, so promoted stars stay sprites; check how the glare reads with real bloom.

Runtime cost: GPU time of the generate / project / sprite passes, the one-time game-thread hitch of the normalising integral when entering a galaxy (D-123), and teleport fill latency (about 37 frames, D-122).
